flagged.comment: Open space area not dimensioned on site plan. Width, depth, and total area must be shown. Currently only area label is provided with no width or depth dimensions. Add dimension callouts showing length and width (minimum 20 ft each for landscaped area) to verify compliance.

Open space area is labeled with total square footage (4,710 sf) but specific width, depth, and length dimensions are not provided. Only total area is dimensioned; individual linear dimensions must be shown for the open space boundaries.

Open space areas not dimensioned on site plan. Width, depth, and total area must be shown for each open space area per the code. Sheet 9 provides only a total area label (4,990 sf) without linear dimension lines showing width and depth. Sheet 31 landscape plan provides no dimensions for the central courtyard/open space area. The minimum 20 ft dimension requirement for plazas and landscaped areas cannot be verified.

Open space areas not delineated on landscape plan with H.5 legend label. Legend defines H.5 but does not apply marker to open space boundary. Apply H.5 legend marker and hatching/shading to all areas comprising the required open space on landscape plan.

The H.5 'Private Common Open Space' hatch pattern is defined in the Key Notes legend on Sheet 31 but is not applied to any area on the actual landscape plan drawing. The open space must be delineated with the appropriate hatch pattern or legend label to match the site plan delineation.

Open space areas not delineated on landscape plan with shading or legend label. The legend identifies 'PRIVATE COMMON OPEN SPACE' (Key Note H.5) with a specific hatching pattern (horizontal lines), but this pattern does not appear anywhere on the landscape plan drawing. The central courtyard area between buildings and other open areas are not visually identified as private common open space on the landscape plan.

Open space square footage inconsistency between plans: Site Plan drawing shows 4,960 SF; Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF provided; Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF provided. These differences (up to 1,149 SF) represent significant inconsistencies. Reconcile all figures, confirm controlling calculation basis, and ensure all sheets reference the same final open space area.

Square footage for common open space shown on plans is inconsistent. Sheet 9 (Site Plan) shows 4,710 sf provided, but Sheet 35 (Landscape Calculations) shows 5,855 sf provided. This 1,145 sf discrepancy must be resolved with consistent documentation across all plan sheets.

Open space square footage shown on plans does not match square footage in site data table. Sheet 9 Site Data Table shows 'Common Open Space provided: 4710 sf'; Sheet 9 site plan drawing label shows 'Common Open Space 4,990 sf'; Sheet 35 Landscape Calculations shows 'Private Common Open Space Provided: 5,855 sf.' These three conflicting values (4,710, 4,990, and 5,855 sf) create inconsistency between graphic and tabular data that prevents verification of compliance.

Open space percentages and square footages inconsistent across sheets. Site Plan shows 4,960 SF/5%; Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF/5%; Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF/6.21%. Landscape Plan does not label open space with H.5. Reconcile all sheets to ensure consistent percentages and square footages.

Open space percentages and delineation are inconsistent across plan sheets. Sheet 9 shows 4,710 sf (5.0% of site area); Sheet 35 shows 5,855 sf (6.2% of site area); Sheet 31 landscape plan does not delineate the open space at all despite being identified in the legend. All sheets must show consistent square footage and graphically represent the same open space area.

Open space percentages inconsistent between plan sheets. Sheet 35 Landscape Calculations states: 'Private Common Open Space - Required: 4,715 sf (5% x 94,293); Provided: 5,855 sf' = 6.21% of 94,203 sf. Sheet 9 Site Data Table shows required 4,709.62 sf and provided 4,710 sf = 5.0% of 94,192 sf. The percentage difference (6.21% vs 5.0%) and conflicting site area values (94,293, 94,203, and 94,192 sf) demonstrate inconsistency that must be resolved.

Type of open space not identified on site plan. Labeled only as 'Common Open Space 4,960 sf' without specifying which of 11 permitted types: natural/undeveloped, landscaped area, plaza/patio, play area, educational/cultural/sensory feature, swimming pool, pond, trail, sports court, transit plaza, or combination. Identify specific type(s) claimed per LDC § 2.7.3.A.

Type of open space is not identified on site plan. The area is labeled 'Common Open Space' but does not identify which of the 11 permitted types it represents: (1) natural and undeveloped, (2) landscaped area, (3) plaza or patio with outdoor seating, (4) play area, (5) educational/cultural/sensory feature, (6) swimming pool, (7) water quality/detention pond, (8) multi-use trail, (9) sports court, (10) transit plaza, or (11) combination. Explicit type designation is required.
areas: Common open space area on site plan

flagged.comment: Type of open space not identified on site plan. Plans do not identify which of the 11 permitted open space types under § 2.7.3.A is being claimed: (1) natural and undeveloped area, (2) landscaped area, (3) plaza or patio with outdoor seating, (4) play area, (5) educational/cultural/sensory feature, (6) swimming pool, (7) water quality/stormwater pond, (8) multi-use trail, (9) sports court, (10) transit plaza, or (11) combination. This identification is required to verify compliance with type-specific requirements.

Compliance with minimum 20 ft dimension and 650 SF area requirements cannot be verified. Site plan shows 4,960 SF (exceeds 650 SF) but provides no width or depth dimensions. Without specific dimension callouts showing both width and depth meet 20 ft minimum, compliance cannot be confirmed. Add dimension callouts to site plan.

Cannot verify whether open space meets Subchapter E minimum dimensional requirements (20 ft minimum width and depth, 650 SF minimum area) because the specific width and depth dimensions are not provided on the site plan. If the open space is claimed as a plaza or landscaped area type, these dimensions must be verified; currently only the total area (4,710 sf) is dimensioned.

Open space designated as plaza or landscaped area does not meet Subchapter E minimum dimensional requirements (20 ft minimum width and depth, 650 SF minimum area). Cannot be verified because neither width nor depth dimensions are provided on the plans. Without these linear dimensions, compliance with the 20 ft minimum dimension requirement cannot be confirmed, and the total area of 4,710-5,855 sf is ambiguous given the conflicting values.

Open space areas not graphically delineated on landscape plan using H.5 hatching. Legend defines H.5 as Private Common Open Space with grid/square hatch pattern but this pattern is not applied to any areas on the actual drawing. Hatch the required minimum open space with H.5 pattern on landscape plan.

Open space areas not graphically delineated on landscape plan using the H.5 (PRIVATE COMMON OPEN SPACE) hatching pattern specified in the legend. While Sheet 9 labels a central courtyard as 'Common Open Space 4,990 sf,' the landscape plan (Sheet 31) contains no H.5 hatch pattern delineation anywhere, and the central courtyard area between buildings is not marked with any pattern distinguishing it as private common open space.

Specific amenities within open space areas not clearly identified and described. Landscape plan shows flagstone/cobblestone pattern and trees within courtyard but no callouts or legend labels identify specific amenities (seating, paths, plantings, etc.). Identify and label all amenities included within the open space on site and landscape plans.

Specific amenities provided within open space areas not identified and described on site plan or landscape plan. While the central courtyard area is labeled on Sheet 9, no amenities are identified within the open space area. Vision analysis of the landscape plan (Sheet 31) confirms that no seating areas, tables, play equipment, shade structures, or other recreational amenities are shown or labeled within the open space. Only decomposed granite walkways and utility lines are noted.

If claimed as landscaped area, cannot verify it exceeds minimum landscaping required by Subchapter C Article 9. Landscape Calculations show multiple landscape categories (Street-Yard, Parking Lot, Private Common Open Space) but breakdown showing which plantings comprise the 5,859 SF private common open space and exceed Article 9 minimums is not clear. Confirm 5,859 SF represents landscaped area exceeding Article 9 requirements.

Landscaped area claimed as open space not demonstrated to exceed the minimum landscaping required by Subchapter C, Article 9. Landscape plans and calculations do not show a breakdown comparing the proposed landscape area within the open space against the minimum landscaping requirements for the site. Cannot verify that landscape area in the open space exceeds the minimum required landscaping by Subchapter C Article 9.

Pedestrian amenities are not identified or shown within the open space areas. The site plan shows only tree symbols and hatching within the central open space courtyard, with no labeled seating, benches, tables, gathering areas, shade structures, or other pedestrian amenities. Required amenities must be identified and depicted on both site plan and landscape plan sheets.

Pedestrian amenities required within open space areas not identified and shown on plans. If the open space is claimed as a plaza or landscaped area (types 2 or 3), pedestrian amenities such as seating, shade structures, pathways, or similar features must be shown on the landscape plan. The landscape plan shows only unpatterned areas and utility lines; no specific pedestrian amenities are delineated or labeled.

Three conflicting open space area figures exist: Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF provided (vs. 4,709.62 SF required), Site Plan drawing shows 4,960 SF, and Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF provided (vs. 4,715 SF required based on 94,293 SF site area). Additionally, site area basis differs (94,192 SF vs 94,293 SF). Cannot determine if minimum 5% requirement is met. Reconcile calculations across all sheets.

Site area basis varies across documents: Sheet 9 uses 94,192 SF; Sheet 35 uses 94,293 SF. This 101 SF difference affects required open space amounts (4,709.62 SF vs. 4,715 SF). Verify controlling site area against legal description and survey; if 94,293 SF is correct, recalculate requirements accordingly.

Open space area not labeled with type. Site plan shows only 'Common Open Space 4,960 sf' without specifying which of the 11 permitted types applies (landscaped area, plaza, play area, etc.). Revise label to include specific open space type per LDC § 2.7.3.A.

Open space not shown as a percentage of the applicable site area in site data table. Sheet 9 Site Data Table shows 'Common Open Space provided: 4710' in square feet only, with no percentage calculation shown. The percentage (5% of gross site area) must be displayed in the site data table for verification of compliance.

Cannot verify open space location outside required street yard. Street yard boundary (between ROW and front building wall, extending to outermost corners parallel to street) is not clearly delineated on site or landscape plan. Cannot confirm designated open space falls outside this exclusion zone. Add street yard boundary delineation to site plan.

Cannot confirm open space excludes parking, loading, driveways, or service areas. Site plan shows designated area in central courtyard (suggesting separation from perimeter parking) but lacks clear boundary delineation and dimension callouts to definitively confirm no parking/driveways encroach into open space. Provide clear boundary delineation.

Cannot fully verify open space is compact and contiguous. Central courtyard appears as single area but lacks clear boundary delineation. Discrepancy between 4,960 SF (site plan) and 5,859 SF (landscape calcs) suggests open space may be fragmented into multiple areas. Clarify location and configuration of all open space areas.

Cannot verify open space is readily accessible and useable. While landscape plan shows flagstone pattern and internal sidewalks suggesting courtyard access, site and landscape plans lack clear documentation of pedestrian access routes, entrances, or amenities demonstrating the space is designed for active use and resident accessibility. Provide callouts and access route documentation.
